name: Podcast & Show Notes
description: Episode summary, topics with timestamps, notable quotes and links mentioned.
outline: Write a two-sentence episode description a listener would see in a podcast app.
Name the host and guests as spoken.
List the topics in order as chapters, with a timestamp in mm:ss if timestamps are present in the transcript.
Quote one to three memorable lines exactly.
List books, tools, people or links that were mentioned.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Chapters
- 00:00 Intro
- 03:40 How the idea started
